hierarchy.notes: Copyable five-command fast start with a deterministic 37-command atlas and explicit local, privacy, usage, and publish rails.

classification.notes: The route renders static command guidance and copies only a user-selected command.

ssa_v2.notes: Fast start, deterministic atlas model, route composition, styling, and tests remain separated.

ssi.notes: One atlas model drives five lanes, 37 commands, launch choreography, impacts, and credits.

sstf.notes: Focused tests lock deterministic totals, impact classification, copy actions, responsive layout, and motion safety.

spe.notes: The default route renders five fast-start commands while the complete atlas stays collapsed until requested.

srs.notes: Copy success or failure is visible and every non-usage or publish boundary is labelled.

ssra.notes: Focused tests, release gate, production build, and live mobile, desktop, and 4K closed and expanded states pass.

sas.notes: Route, atlas model, component, style, and focused test have explicit ownership.

sva.notes: The route performs no command execution, provider access, secret read, or automatic publish.

srls.notes: The brick does not access a database.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: The route inherits Next and React and adds no dependency.

sai.notes: Gen3 intent, lease, source base, decisions, and proof are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The quick start, complete command atlas, deterministic model, styles, metadata, and focused contract remain bounded.

Preview 6a5711158589bede5d916629 and production 6a5711f969a5e7026581f9e7 prove unchanged 343px mobile and 1320px desktop layouts plus centered 2640px 4K fast-start and expanded-manual surfaces.
